title: Custom Cosmetic Packaging Canada RFQ Preparation Source Card
checklist: Prepare jar, bottle, tube or set dimensions before sending an RFQ.
Share packaging type, box style, insert needs, finish direction and target quantity.
Clarify whether the packaging is for retail shelf, e-commerce shipping, gift set or promotional use.
Attach artwork, brand direction or sample references where available.
Ask for sample review and production confirmation steps before approval.
prompt: For a Canada B2B buyer looking for custom cosmetic packaging, what should a buyer prepare before requesting a quote or RFQ, and which public source pages are useful? Cite sources.
